_meta.description: Normalized climatisation service registry for FIXEO Fair Price program. Phase 7B.6. All prices are research references only. No price is production-ready. Human calibration required before any activation.
_meta.REFRIGERANT_INTEGRITY_STATEMENT: This registry treats refrigerant services with full technical integrity. Blind refills are documented as unsafe practices and must never receive a FIXEO fixed-price endorsement. Recharge after leak repair requires prior leak diagnosis. R22 phase-out must be communicated to clients.
_meta.INSTALLATION_SCOPE_STATEMENT: Installation prices in this registry assume client-supplied AC unit. Scope of included copper run is explicitly documented per service. All-in prices including AC equipment are excluded from this registry.

reference_price.derivation_method: Labour component: SRC-CLIM-008 (300–500 labour+vacuum). Refrigerant cost separate: approximately 200–350 MAD/kg retail equivalent. Anchor at 400 MAD labour only. Refrigerant billed by weight consumed.

refrigerant_policy.unsafe_practice_note: CRITICAL: Recharge must only follow confirmed leak repair or documented minor top-up scenario. Top-up without prior CLIM-008 leak detection is an unsafe practice that FIXEO explicitly prohibits. Artisan must document refrigerant quantity added.

complexity_escape_rules: Recharge complète requise → CLIM-012
Compresseur en cause → QUOTE_REQUIRED

services.research_notes: R410A is the dominant refrigerant in Morocco for residential split AC installed 2010–2022. Being phased to R32 in new units.
services.candidate_rationale: Labour-fixed part-separate is correct but client communication is complex. Requires human calibration for refrigerant billing rules.

services.label_fr: Recharge partielle fluide R32 (top-up) — après diagnostic fuite

refrigerant_policy.unsafe_practice_note: R32 is mildly flammable (A2L). Improper handling is a fire hazard. Artisan must use certified equipment. FIXEO must not list artisans for R32 work without verifying A2L certification capability.

services.confidence_justification: 1 primary contractor source. Consistent with R410A evidence adjusted for R32 market pricing.
services.research_notes: R32 growing in Morocco for post-2020 residential split AC. Market awareness of R32-specific requirements still developing.
services.candidate_rationale: Same as CLIM-010 — refrigerant billing complexity. Needs human calibration.

services.label_fr: Recharge R22 — anciens climatiseurs (phase-out en cours au Maroc)

Repeated recharges without addressing the leak are technically inappropriate and financially harmful to the client. services.candidate_rationale: R22 supply volatile. Cannot be fixed priced reliably. Requires DIAGNOSIS_FIRST + DEVIS for refrigerant cost.
